\section{Sheaves}
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal{F}$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-module.
\begin{theorem}
For an affine scheme $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $H^i(X,\mathcal F)=0$ for $i>0$.
\end{theorem}
